theorems.name: Submission.adr_secant_rescaling_of_infinite
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (S : Set (Euclid P)) (σ : ℝ), σ < 1 → (S ∩ ball (0 : Euclid P) σ).Infinite → ∃ (x : Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (zs : ℕ → Euclid P) (z : Euclid P), ‖x‖ < 1 ∧ (∀ k, 0 < lams k) ∧ StrictAnti lams ∧ Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ (∀ k, lams k < 1) ∧ (∀ k, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 - lams k) ∧ (∀ k, x + lams k • zs k ∈ S) ∧ (∀ k, ‖zs k‖ = 1 / 2) ∧ Tendsto zs atTop (𝓝 z) ∧ ‖z‖ = 1 / 2
